description: Privacy-by-default checks: only personal data necessary for each purpose, by default
gate: If any rule is no, overall assessment cannot be PASS

rules.label: Amount of personal data collected
rules.question: By default, does the system collect only the personal data needed for its stated purpose?
rules.pass_example: Meeting title, attendees, and agreed action items only
rules.fail_example: Full audio and transcript stored for every call without a separate opt-in

rules.label: Extent of processing
rules.question: By default, is processing limited to that purpose (no extra matching, profiling, or sharing)?
rules.pass_example: Transcript used only to produce notes for that meeting's attendees
rules.fail_example: Transcripts reused for performance scoring or shared with vendors by default

rules.label: Period of storage
rules.question: By default, is a retention period set and enforced?
rules.pass_example: Audio deleted after 30 days; transcripts kept 90 days then purged
rules.fail_example: Audio and transcripts kept indefinitely with no deletion job

rules.label: Accessibility
rules.question: By default, can only people who need it access the personal data?
rules.pass_example: Role-based access; MFA for anyone who can export transcripts
rules.fail_example: Any operator can export all meeting transcripts from the admin screen
